A1.evidence: Clients: 'Edge-IIoTset was divided into 6 clients based on device types'; only 'client-held validation (stratified 90/10 split)' stated; construction of the test set not described ('Exact client indices and split files are provided in the supplementary package').

A2.evidence: Deep learning models: LSTM 'each flow...fed as a length-1 sequence–treating each flow as one timestep'; Transformer uses pseudo-positions from one feature vector.

A3.evidence: 'Per client, we fit a standard scaler on the training split and apply it unchanged to validation and test.'

A4.evidence: FL setup: 'typically 50 rounds for single-dataset cases and up to 100 for the combined one'; 'training locally for 5 epochs with mini-batches of 128 samples.'

A5.evidence: FedAvg/FedProx/FedNova share settings: 'All clients participated synchronously in each round, training locally for 5 epochs'; identical learning rates/epochs 'to fairly compare FedAvg, FedProx, and FedNova.'

A6.evidence: 'FedAvg is the baseline; FedProx ... and FedNova' implemented by authors; no table of numbers cited from prior works (Tables 5-8).

A7.evidence: Evaluation metrics: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, AUC, Confusion Matrix; no MCC/balanced accuracy/G-mean.

A8.evidence: Edge-IIoTset clients by device type, 'each client had distinct attack profiles'; FedProx 'stabilizes client drift under non-IID class mixtures'; TII-SSRC-23 'stratified random flows...to simulate an i.i.d. setting' (Table 2).

A9.evidence: Only fixed seeds: 'Global seed 42 with dataset seeds Edge=1729, CIC=2023, TII=1103'; no repeated runs or dispersion reported.

A10.evidence: Cross-dataset generalizability: '3 x 2 x 3 design: source dataset ... ' models trained on one dataset tested on the others; 'up to 30 percentage-point macro-F1 loss'.

A11.evidence: No code link; Data availability gives dataset links only; 'split files are provided in the supplementary package'.

notes: A1: test-set construction not stated in the main text (only stratified 90/10 train/validation within clients); coded not_reported. Benign/attack 'roughly balanced'. A8: non-IID arises from device-type partition (Edge-IIoTset), which could be read as a natural split; coded yes because authors construct and describe it as non-IID versus an explicit IID partition for TII-SSRC-23. A5 rounds 'typically 50' (convergence-based).
